organization.name: StreamScan
organization.description: StreamScan is a Montréal cybersecurity company that develops network-behaviour-based threat detection and sells managed cyber defence, incident-response and secure controlled-information services. Its CDS Open XDR platform combines network analysis, machine learning, alert correlation and response automation; StreamEnclave packages monitoring, access control, logging and evidence handling for bounded defence-supply information environments.
organization.commercialStatus: Commercial offerings include CDS Open XDR, StreamShield managed detection and response, incident-response services and StreamEnclave.
organization.defencePosture: StreamScan markets secure-enclave and compliance-support services to organizations preparing to handle controlled information in Canadian and U.S. defence supply chains; this record does not establish certification, eligibility or procurement status.
organization.dualUsePosture: The same IT and OT detection, managed response and incident-response functions are positioned for commercial organizations and critical infrastructure as well as defence suppliers.
organization.currentActivity: On March 16, 2026, StreamScan launched StreamEnclave, an on-site controlled-information environment with separated systems, controlled access, continuous monitoring, centralized logging and compliance-evidence generation for organizations preparing for CMMC or CPCSC requirements.
organization.operatingContext: StreamScan combines a Montréal security operations centre and incident-response team with proprietary detection software. CDS supplies the network and alert-correlation layer; StreamShield adds 24/7 managed monitoring and response; StreamEnclave narrows the technical boundary for controlled information and audit evidence.
organization.canadianFootprint: Founded in 2011 and based in Montréal, StreamScan publishes a Quebec office, describes Canadian product development and R&D, and appears in federal IRAP and Gouvernement du Québec technology-supplier records.
